projects.title: Signoff — 8 operational evidence exports
projects.purpose: Input B for the Signoff gate. These 8 files are the evidence that unblocks the signed_production_evidence gate for Helix-Codex and supplies the ownership / on-call gates.

files.what_it_proves: Every AI-proposed QA action reviewed by a named human
Kill switch / access revocation / access review / retention / PII log checks
AI-proposed decisions named by approver
Escalations go only to authorised supervisors
Named accountable person + least-privilege roster

files.required_columns: ts, row_type, provider_name, reference, term_or_version, owner
files.what_it_proves: AI provider inventory + signed no-training contract term
Staff AI-training completed + verified
Incident notifications within SLA with named owner

projects.note: All 8 files are generatable as FORMAT-EXACT templates. The ROWS must be the client's real exports before Signoff can treat them as evidence.
projects.honesty: Simulated, format-exact template data. The client must replace ONLY the data rows with their own real rows and keep the header, column order and value conventions unchanged. Passing a validator does not make simulated data real compliance evidence.

projects.title: Helix-Codex (Helix-Prime) — nine production gates
projects.purpose: Each gate needs <gate>.evidence.json + .sig stored OUTSIDE the repo, scope production, signed with a key the audited system does not hold.

files.what_it_proves: A cryptographically signed evidence pack produced by an off-system key.
files.operator_note: Createlee produces the 8-file pack. The SIGNATURE must come from a key the audited system does not hold. Declare the public key to the release gate.

files.what_it_proves: Independent certification of tenant/data isolation at production scale.
files.operator_note: Requires a certification body your organisation appoints. No CSV closes this.

files.what_it_proves: Third-party audit of the control plane and audit chain.
files.operator_note: Requires an external auditor. No CSV closes this.

files.what_it_proves: Approved production deployment topology and review sign-off.
files.operator_note: Requires an architecture review by your infrastructure owner.

files.what_it_proves: Validated DR / backup plan exercised against the production environment.
files.operator_note: Requires a real DR test in production. No CSV closes this.

files.what_it_proves: Named production operations owner and rotation.
files.operator_note: Createlee supplies role_spec.csv with exactly one named_accountable=yes; the client fills the name and signs.

files.what_it_proves: Named production on-call and escalation contract.
files.operator_note: Createlee supplies incident_notifications.csv with named owners.

files.what_it_proves: Completed independent security review / penetration test.
files.operator_note: Requires a signed security review. No CSV closes this.

files.what_it_proves: Legal and data-privacy review for the production jurisdiction.
files.operator_note: Requires legal sign-off. No CSV closes this.

files.what_it_proves: Named accountable person + least-privilege roster
files.operator_note: Keep exactly ONE row with named_accountable=yes.

files.what_it_proves: Incident/on-call ownership with named owner
files.operator_note: Owner is never blank; SLA misses stay as honest findings.

projects.title: CompliProof — two reconciled exports + P0 evidence checklist
projects.purpose: Run the reconciliation command against the client's two systems. The 7 P0 production gates are infrastructure evidence, NOT CSVs.

files.required_columns: id (key, non-empty, no duplicates) + business columns
files.what_it_proves: System A side of the reconciliation

files.required_columns: id (key, non-empty, no duplicates) + matching business columns
files.what_it_proves: System B side of the reconciliation

files.required_columns: generated by CompliProof, not filled by the client
files.what_it_proves: Expected reconciliation shape (matched / A-only / B-only / mismatched)
The 7 open P0 gates and exactly what closes each one

projects.reconcile_command: PYTHONPATH=src python -m compliproof.cli reconcile system_a.csv system_b.csv id

findings: key present only in system A - unmatched row preserved
key present only in system A - unmatched row preserved
key present only in system B - unmatched row preserved

cannot_generate: P0-1 Packaging / deployment — NO — needs a hosted CI run and a clean-runner install matrix
P0-2 Evidence integrity — NO — needs an independent reviewer and a non-symmetric key lifecycle
P0-3 Audit ledger — NO — needs an external timestamp anchor receipt (e.g. freetsa)
P0-4 Reporting / reconciliation — PARTIAL — the two CSVs let you run the reconciliation; the served report and audit event must be produced by CompliProof itself
P0-5 Server reporting — NO — needs routes, auth and a security scan
P0-6 Authentication — NO — needs a real auth implementation and security review
P0-7 Dashboard / UI security — NO — needs a browser acceptance test and route inventory
